messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — my feature branch `feature/context-cache` started failing CI after I merged main. Looks like a unit test in kv-layer is consistently red: `kv::cache::expiry_test`
Maria: ugh. Is that the flaky one or a new failure?
Jordan: new. Failing on our macOS/linux matrix both. CI job: https://ci.redwood/integrations/7721/job/45 — error is an assertion about expired entries still being returned.
CI-Bot: Build 7721.45 failed on agent-12 (linux-x86). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/7721/45
Jordan: log snippet: ```
thread 'expiry_test' panicked at 'expected 0, got 1', src/kv/cache.rs:214:10
stack backtrace:
  0: redwood::kv::cache::expire_entry::hb...
  1: redwood::tests::expiry_test::h9a...
```
Kevin: can you repro locally? might be a timing change from the recent timer refactor.
Jordan: I tried `cargo test kv::cache::expiry_test -- --nocapture` inside the docker test image, failed immediately.
Sam: pinging — I shipped the timer refactor in main two commits ago (c3a7b9e -> 4f2d1c3). Could be related.
Natalie: can we do a quick git-bisect to narrow down which of the two commits introduced this?
Jordan: yeah, requesting help — i can run a bisect but CI-only failure would be annoying. Anyone on linux host to run `git bisect run` with the test harness?
Maria: I can run it locally on my ubuntu VM. Steps?
Kevin: workflow: `git bisect start --bad <HEAD> --good <commit-on-main-before-refactor>` then `git bisect run ./ci/scripts/run_fast_kv_test.sh` — the run script exits non-zero on fail so bisect will pick it up.
Jordan: thanks. I'll add a minimal wrapper too to limit iterations. Also adding `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` in the script to get better traces.
Sam: before bisect, try disabling the new timer toggle `FEATURE_TIMER_V2` in env to confirm. If that makes test pass it's likely the refactor.
Jordan: tried that — with `FEATURE_TIMER_V2=0` the test passes locally. So def related. Bisect in progress (Maria taking).
Maria: running now, will update with culprit commit hash. ETA ~ 12m.
CI-Bot: Note: there were 3 recent infra restarts on agent-12; if bisect is noisy, check agent affinity.
Maria: OK bisect found bad commit: 4f2d1c3 (Sam's refactor) — reproduces locally.
Jordan: nice. Can you paste the failing diff or suspected lines?
Maria: looks like in `cache.rs` the expiry check now uses `Instant::elapsed()` without accounting for clock jitter in tests; replacing with `checked_duration_since` and a small epsilon fixes it. Quick patch: ```diff
- if now.elapsed() > ttl { remove(entry); }
+ if now.duration_since(entry.inserted_at) > ttl + Duration::from_millis(2) { remove(entry); }
```
Kevin: small epsilon seems fine, but add a comment referencing CI flakiness. Also add a unit test that advances timers deterministically.
Jordan: I'll open a PR that reverts the unsafe timing assumption and includes a deterministic test harness. @Sam can you review since it's your refactor?
Sam: will review asap. Thanks Maria for bisecting.
Natalie: once PR is up, can we request a focused rerun on the same matrix and then merge?
Jordan: yep will trigger a targeted job and add `ci:rerun` in PR description.
Maria: PR link when ready and I'll smoke-test on my VM. :thumbsup:
Jordan: PR created: https://git.redwood/r/redwood/+/9834 — includes fix + test. CI rerun queued.
CI-Bot: Rerun queued (7722.1) on linux-x86 and macos-12.
Kevin: if green, please squash and merge with message referencing bisect.
Jordan: will do. Thanks everyone.
